whatThisPluginAdds.text: Insights records first-party page views, events, journeys, conversions, and consent state for reporting inside Capell.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins can review overview metrics, trends, journeys, and dashboard widgets. Public pages send consent-aware events through the Insights beacon.

developers.text: Typed Actions handle beacon validation, event storage, rollups, consent, and retention instead of spreading analytics logic across controllers and views.

teams.text: Teams can inspect site activity and conversion paths without sending visitor analytics to a third-party reporting service.
